title: Trapping Essentials
description: An essentail datapack for designing and making traps on a creative world.
body:
# Trapping essentials
This datapack adds essential things to design and make traps!

# Features

## Summon arrows

`/function trapessentials:summonarrow`
Summons 20 arrows of each power level

## Reset trap
`/function trapessentials:resettrap`
does not automatically reset but it kills all armor stands and chest minecarts

## Spawn bot
`/function trapessentials:spawnbot`
spawns a carpet bot that gears up with full protection 4, unbreaking 3, mending armor and doublehanding totems

## Kill bot
`/function trapessentials:kill`
Clears and kills the bot if it survived to be ready for the next time

More features coming soon and if there any typos in the description tell me since this was written on mobile!
